settings.tail_logscore: mean over held-out exceedance frames of log 0.1 + log g(y), then unweighted mean over scenes

G1.rule: Fd tail log-score T2 - T0 > 0 and 95% CI lower bound > 0

G3.rule: I and Fs: n(z > 10) T2 <= T0 and FAR/alpha at 1% in [0.5, 2.5] in >= 11/12 scenes (T2)

G4.rule: SD across scenes of the share above the pooled 99% point: T2 < T0
